data.long_meaning: Mahadevan is a compound name derived from Maha (great) and Devan (god). Mahadevan is considered to be the greatest of all gods in Hinduism, representing the supreme power and creator of the universe. The name Mahadevan carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Mahadevan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahadevan holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, emphasizing the reverence and respect towards the divine deity, Lord Shiva. Lord Shiva, referred to as Mahadeva, is one of the three major gods in Hinduism and is often considered the destroyer and transformer of the universe. Mahadevan is a name that embodies the power, strength, and wisdom associated with Lord Shiva. It is a name that evokes a sense of reverence and respect for the divine power that lies beyond human comprehension.
data.spiritual_significance: Mahadevan is a name deeply rooted in spiritual significance for Hindus. It represents the ultimate power and creator of the universe, symbolizing the highest level of consciousness and self-realization. The name Mahadevan is a reminder of the divine presence within us and inspires a deep sense of devotion towards Lord Shiva and the universal consciousness. It is a name that motivates one to seek spiritual growth and enlightenment. Ultimately, the name Mahadevan is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the divine nature of the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mahadevan, meaning 'God of Gods' in Tamil, symbolizes the supreme power and divinity within an individual, inspiring devotion and reverence towards the ultimate truth. It embodies the highest spiritual ideal of self-realization and union with the Divine.

historical_references.reference: Mahadevan was an important Chola king who ruled from 1122 to 1146 CE and is known for his extensive patronage of temples and religious institutions. He is also known as Mahadeva, or 'God of Gods', due to his deep devotion to Shiva.

Another Mahadevan, who ruled the Pandyan dynasty of South India around the 13th century CE, is also known as Mahadeva and is believed to have been a devotee of Shiva. He is best known for building the famous Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mahadevan, derived from Hindu mythology, holds significant relevance in various modern contexts. In Tamil films, it is a popular surname as seen in renowned actors such as Revathyndr Sarath Kumar and Revathy Sandilya, who have contributed significantly to the Tamil film industry. Mahadevan is also a name deeply rooted in spirituality, with temples and religious centers dedicated to Lord Shiva, who is also known as Mahadev. Lastly, in the realm of technology, Mahadevan is the name of a popular open-source machine learning library used for statistical modeling and time series analysis. This versatility in different spheres of modern life underscores the enduring appeal and relevance of the Hindu name Mahadevan.
